info.title: Field Shift NASA API
info.description: Authenticated farm API with SQL-backed accounts, shared fields, per-user field selections and live Open-Meteo weather. No demo field data is seeded.

schema.title: Response Contexts Api V1 Assistant Contexts Get

post.description: Stateless chat with the farming assistant. Send the whole conversation each time. The system prompt comes from the server's prompt file and cannot be set by the client. Context sections (field, forecast, ML models) come from registered providers; with field_id they are grounded in that field. Streams NDJSON: {"delta": text} lines, then {"done": true}. A stream that ends without done failed.

200.description: NDJSON text deltas followed by a done event on success.

422.description: Invalid conversation or unknown context name

503.description: Assistant or its prompt file is unavailable

get.description: Completed daily model estimates, newest first. Uses saved coordinates, time zone and units. Provide both dates for a custom period of up to 366 days; otherwise days selects a trailing range. Missing readings remain null. Soil moisture is modeled volumetric water content at 0–7 cm. An optional field_id selects field coordinates and returns growing-season limits and daily rule assessments for a supported crop. Field soil inputs refine the limits when available. Climate context summarizes the requested history window.

get.description: 14 daily forecasts, oldest first, starting today in the saved time zone. Shares a 10-minute upstream cache with current weather. Metrics are nullable, wind is the daily maximum and soil moisture is the daily mean at 0–1 cm. An optional field_id selects field coordinates and adds growing-season limits, suitability scores and rule alerts for a supported crop. Field soil inputs refine the limits when available. Climate context summarizes the forecast window. Omitting field_id returns account-location weather with null cropAssessment.
